title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
statement:
Given a list of intervals [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return the merged list.

Two intervals [a, b] and [c, d] overlap if c <= b.

Print the merged intervals sorted by start time, one per line as "start end".
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The next N lines each contain two integers: start and end.
outputFormat: Each merged interval on its own line as "start end".

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
intervals = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
